answer_1.quote: We demonstrate the effectiveness of HumCoE on typical CIR tasks, including asking clarifying questions and the conversational question answering... In our experiments, we assess the task success rate and quality of system responses using automatic evaluation metrics on pre-collected conversational datasets.
answer_1.outputs: Answers to user questions and generated clarifying questions

answer_2.quote: Rouge-L is used to assess the word overlap between the prediction and the ground truth answer... We utilize the accuracy metric to measure the task success rate.

answer_3.quote: We design prompts for ChatGPT scoring and achieve automatic calculation of relevance and naturalness scores... In this case, q(d_i) ∝ 1 -ChatGPT(d_i, ŷ_i).

answer_4.quote: Three annotators independently annotate and evaluate the system responses on the test data... The final human evaluation score for each data is the mean of the scores given by the three annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were provided with the meanings and evaluation protocols of two scores (relevance and naturalness) and scored each system response on a 0-5 scale.
